description: The chart illustrates the GLUE performance of various fine-tuning methods for RoBERTa models of different sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning methods, labeled as Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model, while the vertical axis is labeled "GLUE Performance" with a linear scale ranging from approximately 85 to 89. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a fine-tuning method and containing two bars corresponding to the "base" and "large" RoBERTa sizes, colored blue and orange, respectively. The bars are grouped by fine-tuning method, with the "base" size bars having values ranging from approximately 84.5 to 86.7, and the "large" size bars having values between approximately 85.8 and 88.5. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the fine-tuning methods, and no bars are visually emphasized.
